extracted.name: Black Halloween Punch
extracted.description: This black Halloween punch recipe combines grape and orange drink mixes with ginger ale. Add a spooky frozen hand for a fun party drink.
ingredient_lines: 1 (.13 ounce) envelope unsweetened grape soft drink mix
1 (.13 ounce) envelope unsweetened orange soft drink mix
instruction_lines: Stir grape soft drink mix, orange soft drink mix, sugar, and water together until sugar is dissolved. Stir in chilled ginger ale just before serving.

For an optional frozen hand, fill a food-safe disposable glove with water, secure with a rubber band, and freeze until solid. Dip the frozen hand briefly in warm water, remove and discard the glove, and float the frozen hand in the punch bowl for a spooky effect.
